name: pishe-site-check
description: Check a business website for search engine and AI search visibility problems.

interface.longDescription:
Pishe Website Check audits one public business website for search engine visibility and AI search visibility. It checks 33 factors on the home page plus robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt: title and description, H1, canonical, language, mobile viewport, https and redirects, server response time, sitemap, structured data and how complete the business details in it are (address, phone, opening hours, social profiles), FAQ content, readable text without JavaScript, freshness signals, clickable phone and contact form. It also tests whether the major AI crawlers can actually open the site, which catches firewalls that block them even when robots.txt allows them.

It returns a search score, an AI visibility score and a list of findings in Bulgarian that state what was measured and why it matters for the business. The AI visibility score measures readiness; it does not show whether AI assistants already recommend the business.

Built for small and medium businesses in Bulgaria by Pishe, the website service of Raboti. If the user wants help with the problems, the plugin can send a contact request to the Pishe team with the results, only after the user explicitly agrees to share their name and contact details.

Limitations: it checks the home page and the files above, not the whole site. It only checks public websites, does not log in and does not change anything on the checked site. Speed is a single server response measurement. The server does not use an AI model and does not store the checked addresses.
capabilities: Audit a public business website for search engines
Check AI search readiness and AI crawler access
Explain the impact of each problem in Bulgarian
Send a help request to Pishe with user consent
defaultPrompt: Провери сайта kodent.bg за търсачки и AI търсене.
Защо AI асистентите не препоръчват моята клиника?
Check raboti.bg for SEO and AI visibility.

positive.prompt: Провери сайта hotelchiflika.com за търсачки и AI търсене.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a low search score and a low AI visibility score, with Bulgarian findings such as very little readable text, no H1, no structured data, no sitemap and AI crawlers receiving 403; each finding states why it matters.

positive.prompt: Check raboti.bg for SEO and AI search problems.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns high search and AI visibility scores (90+/100) with at most a few low-severity findings, and notes that only the home page was checked.

positive.prompt: Защо kodent.bg не излиза добре в търсачките?
positive.expected_behavior: Normalises the address, checks https://kodent.bg/ and reports findings such as missing H1, missing structured data, missing sitemap, http not redirecting to https and one AI crawler being refused.

positive.description: Request a fix after the audit, with consent
positive.prompt: Провери orenda-bg.com. После: Да, искам Pishe да го оправи. Казвам се Тест Тестов, имейл test@example.com, съгласен съм да изпратите данните ми на Raboti.
positive.expected_behavior: After the audit and the user's explicit consent, sends one fix request with the site, score and findings, and confirms that Pishe will reply within one working day.

positive.prompt: Защо AI асистентите не препоръчват сайта hotelchiflika.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the AI visibility score, which AI crawlers are blocked in a live test, missing structured data and too little readable text, and states that the score measures readiness, not actual recommendations.

negative.prompt: Изпрати на Pishe моя имейл ivan@example.com, но не съм съгласен да споделяте данните ми.
Направи ми нов сайт и го качи на хостинга ми.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. It can send a contact request to the Pishe team only with the user's explicit consent.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: website audit for search engines and AI search visibility, and an optional help request to Pishe with explicit user consent.

bg-BG.subtitle: Одит на сайт: търсачки и AI
bg-BG.description:
Pishe проверява публичен фирмен сайт за търсачки и за AI търсене. Проверява 33 фактора на началната страница и файловете robots.txt, sitemap.xml и llms.txt, и тества дали основните AI ботове могат да отворят сайта. Получавате оценка за търсачки, оценка за AI търсене и списък с проблеми на български: какво намерихме и защо е важно за бизнеса ви. Оценката за AI търсене показва готовност, а не дали AI асистентите вече ви препоръчват.

Ако искате помощ, плъгинът може да изпрати заявка към екипа на Pishe от Raboti заедно с резултата, само след вашето изрично съгласие.

Ограничения: проверява само началната страница и посочените файлове. Не влиза с парола и не променя нищо по сайта. Сървърът не използва AI модел и не пази проверените адреси.
